song: Are You Gonna Go My Way

productionAnnotations.text: Use kill switch to add effect to this.

patternDefinitions.em-riff-a: Odd-measure Em riff half: full-step bend from fret 2, release/open-note movement and lower-string support.
patternDefinitions.em-riff-b: Even-measure Em riff half: continuation with optional terminal 3/3 dyad where printed.
patternDefinitions.g-position-riff-a: G-position transposition centered on fret 5 with full-step bend, release to fret 3 and vibrato.
patternDefinitions.picked-muted-turnaround: Picked turnaround containing explicit dead-note X attacks and picking-direction marks.
patternDefinitions.chorus-g6: G6 chorus voicing and repeated chord attacks.
patternDefinitions.chorus-e-d-e: Chorus E to D to E chord movement.
patternDefinitions.chorus-g-e: Chorus G to E chord movement.
patternDefinitions.bridge-e-d: Bridge left-side E to D muted chord figure.
patternDefinitions.bridge-a-e: Bridge right-side A to E movement with sustained/slid voicings.
patternDefinitions.solo-backing-e-d: Solo rhythm backing E to D muted chord figure.
patternDefinitions.solo-backing-a-d6-a: Solo rhythm backing A to D6 to A figure.
patternDefinitions.full-measure-rest: Printed empty/rest measure that must remain present.
patternDefinitions.outro-held-atp2: A(tp2) chord sustained/tied across the barline without invented re-attacks.
